comment: DISPOSABLE hardware probe for _init parameter materialization. Gain defaults to 0, so an effect whose params were zeroed on load is SILENT and one whose params materialized is AUDIBLE. Not a musical effect; never ship it.

params.name: Gain
params.comment: Output level. DEFAULT 0 on purpose: if params are zeroed on load this falls back to silence, which is the failure signal.

params.name: Tone
params.comment: One-pole low-pass, dark to bright. Second knob so the _init has more than one handler to call.
